parsed.name: CVD沉积工艺控制系统
parsed.description: 用于化学气相沉积（CVD）实验的工艺控制设备/系统，通常包含反应腔体加热温控、工艺配方（步骤）执行，以及多路工艺气体的流量设定与监控（常见为质量流量控制器MFC）。可按配方启动/停止工艺，并记录或回放工艺设定与相关参数变化。
parsed.description_en: A process control system for Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) experiments, typically integrating reactor temperature setpoint control, recipe (step) execution, and multi-gas flow setpoint/monitoring (commonly via mass flow controllers, MFCs). It supports starting/stopping a recipe and managing process setpoints and parameter trends during deposition runs.

actions.description: 获取当前工艺界面中的配方/设定点字段
actions.description_en: Get the current recipe/setpoint fields from the control interface

actions.description: 保存工艺配方到文件（包含元数据与气体列信息）
actions.description_en: Save a process recipe to a file (including metadata and gas column information)

actions.description: 从文件打开工艺配方并加载到控制界面
actions.description_en: Open a process recipe from a file and load it into the control interface

actions.description: 更新工艺参数趋势图（如多路气体流量随时间变化）
actions.description_en: Update process trend plots (e.g., multi-gas flow vs. time)

actions.description: 启动配方运行并开始执行工艺步骤
actions.description_en: Start running a recipe and begin executing process steps

actions.description: 应用当前设定点（如温度与气体流量设定）到工艺控制
actions.description_en: Apply current setpoints (e.g., temperature and gas flow setpoints) to process control
